'''Fold space''' or being able to '''Transmigrate''', was a [[Force power/Legends|Force power]] that allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-user]] to bend [[Realspace/Legends|space]] to instantly transport an object between places.<ref name="JATM">''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]''</ref> This form of teleportation was used by the [[Aing-Tii/Legends|Aing-Tii]], a mysterious [[Species/Legends|species]] living on a [[Aing-Tii homeworld|planet]] in the [[Kathol Rift/Legends|Kathol Rift]]. This technique allowed the wielder to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to teleport any object or possibly oneself from one place to another.<ref name="FotJ:O" />

In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], when [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his son, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Ben Skywalker]], visited the Aing-Tii [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], Luke was taught the technique by [[Tadar'Ro]].<ref name="FotJ:O" /> Abeloth utilized this ability while [[Mission to the Maw|battling]] an allied force of [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith]] and Jedi in [[44 ABY]].<ref name="FotJ:A">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref>

In 45 ABY, Luke Skywalker and Leia Organa Solo used this power to advance upon the Qrephs while inside the Monolith.<ref name="Crucible novel">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>

Fold space was also used in a way known as "Aura of Freedom", which allowed the user and nearby allies to resist being moved with the Force.<ref name="JATM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fold space first appeared in ''Dark Empire 3'', where Vima-Da-Boda teleported away from Leia Solo in a puff of white mist, then as an unnamed Force power in the [[1998]] novel ''[[Vision of the Future]]'', written by [[Timothy Zahn]]. It was first identified as "Fold space" in the ''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]'', a supplement for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'', that was released on [[May 19]], [[2009]].
